newsitem.title: USA: Cistron says settles with PeproTech.
newsitem.headline: Cistron says settles with PeproTech.

text.p: Cistron Biotechnology Inc said Wednesday it had settled with PeproTech a patent infringement claim against PeproTech regarding Interleukin-1 beta (IL-1b).
Under the agreement, PeproTech has paid Cistron $718,000 for licensing fees and other expenses, Cistron said.
Cistron said PeproTech may sell IL-1b in domestic and international research markets in accordance with certain licensing agreements between the company.

The agreement also provides Cistron additional royalties. The consortium of Massachusetts universities, which licensed to Cistron the company's initial IL-1b patent, will share in the PeproTech payments.
Cistron said that a result of the settlement, PeproTech has filed a motion to dismiss its Chapter 11 bankruptcy proceeding.
